attchmntText: Ptc Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation .
voiceSummary: PTC Industries Limited filed an investor presentation for the second quarter and half of fiscal year 2027 with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The company reported consolidated total income of 426.5 crore rupees for the half year, representing a 77.3 percent year-on-year increase. Profit after tax rose 168.2 percent to 62.5 crore rupees. For the quarter, total income was 229.4 crore rupees, with profit after tax at 33.3 crore rupees. Aerolloy Technologies secured an agreement with Airbus for titanium castings and received a development order from Safran Aircraft Engines for the LEAP engine programme. The company completed a qualified institutions placement of 1,800 crore rupees, issuing 8,54,700 equity shares at 21,060 rupees per share. PTC also signed a memorandum of understanding with the Uttar Pradesh government for the STrIDE Academy to support industrial skills development.

attchmntText: Ptc Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "PTC Industries Reports Strong H1FY27 Performance;Profit After Tax Rises 168% over H1FY26".
voiceSummary: PTC Industries Limited disclosed financial results for the half year and quarter ended 30 September 2026. Consolidated total income rose 77.3% year on year to Rs. 4,264.9 million. EBITDA increased 116.9% to Rs. 1,155.7 million. Profit after tax grew 168.2% to Rs. 624.7 million. For the second quarter, total income rose 72.7% to Rs. 2,293.8 million. EBITDA increased 80.9% to Rs. 613.6 million. Profit after tax rose 83.5% to Rs. 332.8 million. The company signed an agreement with Airbus for titanium castings. Aerolloy Technologies received a development order from Safran Aircraft Engines. PTC completed a Rs. 1,800 crore Qualified Institutions Placement. The company issued 8,54,700 equity shares at Rs. 21,060 per share.

attchmntText: Ptc Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 6366  Shares.
voiceSummary: PTC Industries Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved the allotment of 6,366 equity shares of Rs. 10 each under the PTC Employee Stock Option Scheme 2019 at an exercise price of Rs. 402 per share. Paid-up share capital increased from Rs. 15,84,72,490 to Rs. 15,85,36,150. Consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 22,431.91 lakhs. Consolidated profit before tax for the quarter was Rs. 4,042.97 lakhs. Consolidated profit for the half year ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 6,247.08 lakhs. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026.

PTC Industries Limited filed the final Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with ICRA Limited. The report confirms no material deviation in the utilization of proceeds from the Qualified Institutional Placement issued in August 2024. The issue size was INR 699.9999 crores, comprising 5,30,315 equity shares at Rs. 13199.70 each. Net proceeds were INR 673.2558 Crore. Utilization includes INR 50.0000 Crore for loan repayment, INR 209.0000 Crore for capital expenditure, INR 71.0000 Crore for working capital, and INR 175.0000 Crore for inorganic growth. INR 168.5117 Crore was allocated to general corporate purposes. As of the quarter end, INR 50.0471 Crore remains unutilized. The repayment and working capital objects are completed. Capital expenditure and general corporate purposes are on schedule. Issue-related expenses were lower than estimated by INR 0.2559 Crore.
